findings.label: Expenses tab switcher emphasis inverts in dark
findings.detail: EXPENSES.dark.tabIdleText = textPrimary #f3eefc is brighter than the active primaryFg #c4a3ff, and the active pill (surface #1e1430) is darker than the track (surfaceAlt #2a1d42). Confirm at the screenshot pass; if confirmed, record a design exception (e.g. idle -> textSecondary, a lighter active pill) and add a dark idle-vs-active assertion.

findings.label: Tier count pill active state vanishes in dark
findings.detail: ExpenseFormModal tierCountPillCard (rowActiveBg + violetHairline) and tierCountPillCardActive (quickActionBg + violetBorderActive) both resolve to violet.tint #392b51 + violet.border #584678. Give the active pair a distinct dark value (e.g. border primaryFg) as a recorded exception.

findings.label: Alcohol Switch 'on' reads weaker than 'off'
findings.detail: FORM_SWITCH.dark.trackOn #584678 is nearly identical to trackOff #4a3a6b, and the #7e57c2 on-thumb is dimmer than the white off-thumb. Consider trackOn -> violet.fill/primaryFg by exception and add a test (switch colours are untested).

findings.label: Ink-indigo names become accent-violet
findings.detail: #1e1b4b (member/flow names, Balances active toggle text) -> DARK_TONAL.violet.fg, which equals primaryFg, so names share the link/accent hue in dark where light shows near-black ink. Rule-compliant; check in screenshots whether textPrimary is the intended role.

findings.label: Two TextInputs lack keyboardAppearance
findings.detail: ExpenseFormModal matrixCountInput and tierCountInput sit in tiers.map((t, tIdx)) callbacks that shadow the theme and were skipped. Rename the parameter (as done for the tier-name block) and add keyboardAppearance={t.scheme}.

findings.label: Dark-only placeholder ternary is an undocumented design deviation
findings.detail: Six TextInputs use t.scheme === 'dark' ? t.color.textSecondary : undefined instead of the design's unconditional textSecondary, which is correct for light parity (Property 8). The integrator should record this in design.md's third-party/native rules so batches stay consistent.

findings.label: Typecheck/related-tests evidence is scoped
findings.detail: C5 used a temporary out-of-repo tsconfig over B4 files (881 files, exit 0) because root tsc stops on B7's ChangePasswordControl.tsx(290,3) TS1005. Integration must run the full npm run verify.

findings.label: Untested dark values
findings.detail: FORM_SWITCH, AVATAR_FILL, tier matrix/count pill states, TripSchedule settings/item-settings modals, park-hours stripes and the Expenses idle-tab label have no dark assertions; findings 2 and 3 live in this gap, so they need screenshot coverage.

findings.label: showtimePillActive primary fill on surfaceAlt
findings.detail: Flagged by the coder (DoD 8); the integrator should check its contrast against the iteration-3 surfaceAlt pairs.
